findings.title: Index Out of Bounds Error in Certificate Query Filter
findings.impact: Denial of Service - Unhandled IndexError causes 500 error
findings.evidence:
Code: common_name = args.pop("filter").split(";")[1]
Accesses index [1] without checking if split() returned enough elements. If filter parameter is provided without semicolon or with insufficient parts, raises IndexError.
findings.recommendation: Add bounds checking before accessing split result: terms = filt.split(";"); if len(terms) > 1: common_name = terms[1] else: return error response

findings.title: Index Out of Bounds Error in Certificate Render Function
findings.impact: Denial of Service - Unhandled IndexError causes 500 error
findings.evidence:
Code: term = f"%{terms[1]}%"
Accesses index [1] without checking if split(";") returned enough elements. Missing bounds validation allows malformed filter parameters to crash the application.
findings.recommendation: Add bounds checking: if len(terms) < 2: raise ValueError("Invalid filter format"). Validate that filter has at least two parts (key;value).

findings.title: Unchecked Config Callable Execution
findings.impact: Denial of Service / Application Crash - TypeError if config value is None
findings.evidence:
Code: message, code = current_app.config.get("CERTIFICATE_CREATE_REQUEST_VALIDATION")(data)
Calls config value as function without checking if it's None first. If configuration key is not set, get() returns None, causing TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable.
findings.recommendation: Check if callback exists before calling: validator = current_app.config.get("CERTIFICATE_CREATE_REQUEST_VALIDATION"); if validator: message, code = validator(data)

findings.title: Unchecked Config Callable Execution - Export Key Validation
findings.impact: Denial of Service - TypeError if config value is None
findings.evidence:
Code: message, code = current_app.config.get("CERTIFICATE_EXPORT_KEY_REQUEST_VALIDATION")(cert, g.current_user)
Same pattern as F-003. No null check before calling retrieved function.
findings.recommendation: Check if callback exists: validator = current_app.config.get("CERTIFICATE_EXPORT_KEY_REQUEST_VALIDATION"); if validator: message, code = validator(cert, g.current_user)

findings.title: Unchecked Config Callable Execution - Update Validation
findings.impact: Denial of Service - TypeError if config value is None
findings.evidence:
Code: message, code = current_app.config.get("CERTIFICATE_UPDATE_REQUEST_VALIDATION")(data, cert)
Pattern repeated multiple times (lines 952, 1107, 1280, etc). No validation that config callback exists.
findings.recommendation: Add null checks for all config-driven callbacks before invocation to prevent TypeError.

findings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in OpenID Connect Validation
findings.impact: Server-Side Request Forgery - Can make requests to internal services/metadata endpoints
findings.evidence:
Code: r = requests.get(jwks_url)
Fetches JWKS from user-provided or config-specified URL without validating it. jwks_url comes from OpenID Connect provider configuration and could be manipulated to access internal services.
findings.recommendation: Validate JWKS URL: check URL scheme is https only, validate against allowlist of known IdP endpoints, use requests library with allow_redirects=False and timeout set.

findings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in User Information Retrieval
findings.impact: Server-Side Request Forgery - Can make requests to internal services
findings.evidence:
Code: r = requests.get(user_api_url, params=user_params, headers=headers)
Fetches user info from URL without validation. user_api_url is configuration-driven and could be manipulated to probe internal network or services.
findings.recommendation: Validate user_api_url scheme and domain: enforce https only, validate against allowlist of known OAuth/OpenID Connect providers, set strict timeout and disable redirects.

findings.title: Index Out of Bounds Error in Database Filter Helper
findings.impact: Denial of Service - Unhandled IndexError in database operations
findings.evidence:
Code: column = get_model_column(model, underscore(terms[0])); return query.filter(column.ilike(f"%{terms[1]}%"))
Accesses terms[1] without validating that split() produced sufficient parts. Called from certificate rendering with user-supplied filter parameters.
findings.recommendation: Validate terms length: if len(terms) < 2: raise ValueError("Invalid filter format"). Add consistent validation for all filter parsing operations.
